programs.name: las2su
programs.purpose: Convert LAS well-log curves into SU traces and save the LAS header.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: LAS2SU - convert las2 format well log curves to su traces

params.name: ncurve
params.default: computed: count lines in the LAS ~C block
params.description: Number of curves; overrides automatic counting.

params.name: dz
params.description: Input depth interval in feet.

params.name: m
params.description: Set to 1 to express output depth headers in meters.

params.name: ss
params.description: Set to 1 to subsample; the implementation applies both subsampling passes, yielding every fourth sample.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print curve count and subsampling diagnostics.

params.name: outhdr
params.description: Output file for LAS header lines.

params.name: nskip
params.description: Appears in the usage line but is ignored and is not read by the implementation.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: ASCII values are converted with atof and stored as floats; depth headers mix float and double arithmetic and dt is converted to an integer header. fgets requests 400 bytes into a 300-byte array, input can overrun the allocated depth array before subsampling, and missing tokens can cause undefined behavior.
programs.difficulty_reason: It parses a stateful LAS header and buffers and transposes all curves before output.

test_cases.description: Explicit curve count and metric depth headers; LAS input must be constructed because SU trace generators do not emit LAS.
test_cases.command:
printf '~C
DEPT .FT
VP .M/S
~P
~A
100 2000
101 2100
102 2200
103 2300
' | las2su ncurve=2 dz=1 m=1 outhdr=las_header.asc > out.su

test_cases.description: Automatic curve count and requested subsampling.
test_cases.command:
printf '~C
DEPT .FT
VP .M/S
~P
~A
100 2000
101 2100
102 2200
103 2300
104 2400
105 2500
106 2600
107 2700
' | las2su dz=1 ss=1 verbose=1 outhdr=las_header.asc > out.su

programs.license_note: Credits state that Chris Liner's code was released with Saudi Aramco permission and was based on code by Ferhan Ahmed and a2b.c; lasstrip by Werner Heigl is also credited.

programs.name: subackus
programs.purpose: Calculate Backus-averaged anisotropy and optional elastic properties from velocity and density logs.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUBACKUS - calculate Thomsen anisotropy parameters from

params.name: navg
params.description: Averaging window in samples; nondefault values are rounded up to an odd integer.

params.name: all
params.description: Set to 1 to output additional elastic and input-log traces.

params.name: ang
params.description: Angle in degrees for the phase-velocity ratio.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Window sums accumulate in float order; formulas mix float values with double literals and use sin, cos and sqrt. Zero or invalid elastic properties can produce nonfinite values; oversized windows can access outside arrays.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers three logs and computes several coupled window averages and optional output traces.

test_cases.description: Three positive synthetic logs with a short averaging window.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=3 | suop op=abs | suop2 op=sum2 in2=<(sunull nt=128 ntr=3 | suaddhead ns=128) | sugain bias=2000 | subackus navg=11 all=0 ang=25 > out.su

test_cases.description: All output properties and an even window rounded to odd.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=3 | suop op=abs | sugain bias=2000 | subackus navg=10 all=1 ang=45 > out.su

programs.license_note: Chris Liner credits Saudi Aramco permission to release the code and cites Thomsen's SEG DISC Notes.

programs.name: subackush
programs.purpose: Calculate Backus-averaged elastic and anisotropy logs with optional gamma-ray-based shale anisotropy.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUBACKUSH - calculate Thomsen anisotropy parameters from

params.name: navg
params.description: Averaging window in samples; values other than 201 are rounded up to an odd integer.

params.name: gr
params.description: Set to 1 to read a fourth gamma-ray trace.

params.name: grs
params.description: Pure-shale gamma-ray value.

params.name: grc
params.description: Zero-shale gamma-ray value.

params.name: smode
params.description: Use shale anisotropy proportional to shale volume; 0 applies it to pure shale only.

params.name: se
params.description: Shale epsilon.

params.name: sd
params.description: Shale delta.

params.name: sg
params.description: Shale gamma.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Float window accumulation and mixed float/double expressions use pow and sqrt. The shale-volume array is not initialized when gr=0, and oversized windows can access outside arrays.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers multiple logs and computes coupled window averages with optional shale-dependent stiffnesses.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=3 | suop op=abs | sugain bias=2000 | subackush navg=11 gr=0 > out.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=4 | suop op=abs | sugain bias=100 | subackush navg=10 gr=1 grc=10 grs=100 smode=0 se=0.2 sd=0.03 sg=0.19 > out.su

programs.license_note: Chris Liner credits Saudi Aramco permission to release the code and cites Thomsen's SEG DISC Notes.

programs.name: sugassmann
programs.purpose: Generate a synthetic trace of reflectivity sensitivity to reservoir fluid and rock properties.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGASSMAN - Model reflectivity change with rock/fluid properties

params.name: nt
params.description: Requested sample count; mode 0 replaces it with 200.

params.name: ntr
params.description: Requested trace count; mode 0 replaces it with 1.

params.name: dt
params.description: Time sampling interval in seconds.

params.name: mode
params.description: Only 0 and 1 survive validation; mode 0 produces a sensitivity trace, mode 1 produces no traces, and the mode 2 branch is unreachable.

params.name: it1
params.description: Nominal spike index; read but unused.

params.name: temp
params.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius.

params.name: pres
params.description: Pressure in MPa; selfdoc says 20.

params.name: v1
params.description: Caprock P-wave velocity; selfdoc gives a different default.

params.name: r1
params.description: Caprock density; selfdoc gives a different default.

params.name: g
params.description: Gas specific gravity.

params.name: api
params.description: Oil API gravity.

params.name: s
params.description: Brine salinity fraction; selfdoc says 35.

params.name: so
params.description: Oil saturation.

params.name: sg
params.description: Gas saturation.

params.name: kmin
params.description: Mineral bulk modulus in MPa.

params.name: mumin
params.description: Mineral shear modulus in MPa.

params.name: rmin
params.description: Mineral density.

params.name: phi
params.description: Porosity.

params.name: a
params.description: Frame stiffness fitting coefficient.

params.name: b
params.description: Frame stiffness fitting coefficient.

params.name: c
params.description: Frame stiffness fitting exponent.

params.name: h
params.description: Reservoir thickness; used only in unreachable mode 2.

params.name: p
params.description: Fractional sensitivity range used by mode 0.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Long empirical expressions mix float intermediates and double constants with many pow and sqrt calls; platform math and evaluation order affect results. Invalid fluid properties can produce nonfinite values. Mode 2 is reset to 0 before its branch and mode 1 has no output branch.
programs.difficulty_reason: Its lengthy coupled empirical rock and fluid formulas require careful numerical transcription.

test_cases.description: Sensitivity trace with modified rock and fluid parameters.
test_cases.command: sugassmann nt=128 ntr=2 mode=0 p=0.1 phi=0.2 so=0.6 sg=0.2 pres=20 > out.su

test_cases.description: Mode 1 exercises the implemented empty-output path.
test_cases.command: sugassmann nt=128 ntr=2 mode=1 dt=0.002 it1=30 > out.su
sugassmann nt=128 ntr=2 mode=2 p=0.05 s=0.1 > out.su

programs.name: sulprime
programs.purpose: Search odd Backus averaging lengths for the one closest to a target Backus number.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SULPRIME - find appropriate Backus average length for

params.name: b
params.description: Target Backus number.

params.name: dz
params.description: Input depth interval in feet.

params.name: f
params.description: Frequency in Hz.

params.name: nmax
params.description: Maximum averaging window length in samples.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Set to 1 for intermediate results; selfdoc incorrectly gives the default as 1.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The search repeatedly accumulates float window sums and uses sqrt and fabs with mixed float and double arithmetic; small numerical differences can change the selected window. Results are written to stderr.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers logs and searches many averaging windows using repeated numerical calculations.

test_cases.description: Search a small range and print intermediate results.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=3 | suop op=abs | sugain bias=2000 | sulprime b=0.3 dz=0.5 f=40 nmax=21 verbose=1

test_cases.description: Search with a different target and sampling interval.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=3 | suop op=abs | sugain bias=1500 | sulprime b=2 dz=1 f=60 nmax=31 verbose=0

programs.license_note: Chris Liner credits Saudi Aramco permission to release the code.

programs.name: suwellrf
programs.purpose: Convert binary depth, velocity, and density logs into time-sampled normal-incidence reflectivity traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUWELLRF - convert WELL log depth, velocity, density data into a

params.name: nval
params.description: Number of input depth, velocity, and density records.

params.name: dvrfile
params.description: Interleaved binary depth, velocity, and density file; takes precedence over other file forms.

params.name: dvfile
params.description: Interleaved depth and velocity file; paired with drfile.

params.name: drfile
params.description: Interleaved depth and density file; the paired-file branch checks dvfile twice and then opens drfile.

params.name: dfile
params.description: Binary depth file for the three-file form.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary velocity file for the three-file form.

params.name: rhofile
params.description: Binary density file for the three-file form.

params.name: dtout
params.default: computed: minimum input two-way interval divided by 2
params.description: Output time interval in seconds; selfdoc says .004.

params.name: ntr
params.description: Number of identical output traces.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Traveltime accumulation and sample-index rounding use mixed float and double arithmetic, followed by eight-point sinc interpolation. The final reflectivity is written at maxtrace[ntmax], one past its allocation; missing file combinations leave zero input values, and the paired-file condition checks dvfile twice.
programs.difficulty_reason: It supports multiple binary input layouts, builds a reflectivity series, and resamples it with sinc interpolation.

test_cases.description: Interleaved input and explicit output sampling; a2b creates the required non-SU binary input.
test_cases.command:
printf '0 2000 2.0
10 2200 2.1
20 2400 2.2
' | a2b n1=3 > dvr.bin && suwellrf dvrfile=dvr.bin nval=3 dtout=0.002 ntr=2 > out.su

test_cases.description: Separate depth-velocity and depth-density files with computed output sampling.
test_cases.command:
printf '0 2000
10 2200
20 2400
' | a2b n1=2 > dv.bin && printf '0 2.0
10 2.1
20 2.2
' | a2b n1=2 > dr.bin && suwellrf dvfile=dv.bin drfile=dr.bin nval=3 ntr=1 > out.su

printf '0
10
20
' | a2b n1=1 > d.bin && printf '2000
2200
2400
' | a2b n1=1 > v.bin && printf '2.0
2.1
2.2
' | a2b n1=1 > rho.bin && suwellrf dfile=d.bin vfile=v.bin rhofile=rho.bin nval=3 dtout=0.001 ntr=1 > out.su
